purpose: Candidate-bound whole-body visual/anatomical motion realism audit. Additive to existing numerical deformation/contact gates.
invariants: Do not modify or re-pin R2, P2B1, P3B1 or Phase 4 freeze evidence.
Do not weaken acceptance thresholds, contact tolerances or frozen poses.
No V-series or third-party geometry, weights, bind data, textures, scans, projection or transferred implementation data.
External human references are observation evidence only.
Owner review remains distinct from engineering verification.

CRITICAL.meaning: Visually impossible, mechanically broken or contact-destroying deformation.

HIGH.meaning: Clearly non-human anatomy visible at ordinary review distance or severe motion pop/collapse.

MEDIUM.meaning: Noticeable secondary-form or close-view realism defect.

LOW.meaning: Minor tertiary/presentation issue without meaningful motion consequence.

regions.name: Head / neck / trapezius
expected: neck mass remains continuous through head/torso motion
trapezius changes contour without a rigid collar or rear shelf
no cervical pinching or hollowing

regions.name: Clavicle / shoulder / deltoid
expected: humeral cap remains rounded and attached
clavicular/acromial landmarks stay plausible
no cap collapse, shelf, dislocation look or popping

regions.name: Chest / pectorals / anterior axilla
expected: pectoral mass stays continuous with chest
anterior axillary fold rises/changes angle with humeral elevation
axillary hollow changes continuously rather than forming a rigid tunnel

regions.name: Scapular back / lats / posterior axilla
expected: back drape follows scapular/arm motion
posterior axillary fold stays continuous
no floating lobe, rear shelf or fixed crease

regions.name: Ribcage / abdomen / obliques / lumbar
expected: torso retains coherent volume
waist changes softly under flexion/extension
no rigid six-pack blocks, membrane stretch or barrel collapse

regions.name: Upper arm / elbow
expected: biceps/triceps contours change with flexion
elbow crease appears under compression and relaxes
no cylindrical hinge or ring crease

regions.name: Forearm / wrist
expected: forearm mass rotates/tapers plausibly
wrist narrows without collapse
loaded extension does not create a hard trench or twist artifact

regions.name: Palm / thumb web / fingers
expected: palm remains volumetric rather than slab-like
thumb web clears equipment
finger joints articulate without crease-ring collision
loaded grip/contact remains credible

regions.name: Pelvis / groin / glute
expected: groin remains continuous under deep flexion
glute mass changes with hip flexion
no crotch tunnel, hip shelf or posterior collapse

regions.name: Thigh / knee
expected: quad/adductor/hamstring masses remain coherent
patellar/condylar silhouette stays plausible
posterior knee compresses without a fixed deep ring

regions.name: Calf / ankle / Achilles
expected: calf tapers naturally
Achilles remains continuous
ankle dorsiflexion does not cave, shear or break floor contact

regions.name: Foot / toes
expected: heel/arch/ball remain grounded when required
toe roots and tips retain plausible shape
no sole collapse, toe fusion or floor penetration

exit_rules: Every region has neutral, lengthened/elevated, compressed/loaded and intermediate-transition evidence where anatomically applicable.
Every movement family has been sampled or explicitly marked not applicable with rationale.
Every CRITICAL and HIGH defect is FIXED_VERIFIED or the affected candidate is REJECTED_CANDIDATE.
Every MEDIUM defect is FIXED_VERIFIED or explicitly dispositioned.
No visual repair introduces a development blocker, contact loss or material regression versus direct parent, active epoch baseline or Phase 4 freeze.
Real renders and manifests are bound to the exact candidate SHA-256.
Owner visual review is recorded separately and never inferred.
Passing this audit does not set production_approved true.
